lava._about: Lava pit hazard and glow (world/inferno.rs). damage_per_second: health lost each second the body is within touch_margin metres of a lava cell (the pit is closed to walking, so this is the edge and a fall). glow: the light a lava cell gives, colour 0..1, range in metres, strength. The surface look is data/render/inferno.json lava_surface.

terrain._about: Noisy floor and ceiling of the caverns (world/inferno_terrain.rs): smooth value noise sampled at every grid corner of the world, so a body stands on the same surface the renderer draws and chunks join without a seam. Heights are metres above the level's floor line (0 = the maze floor). floor: amplitude is the largest rise or dip, scale the cells between noise lattice points of the first octave (each next octave halves it), persistence the amplitude kept per octave. ceiling: amplitude is the deepest sag of the ceiling below the slab line (storey - slab); min_headroom is the least clear height over the floor (at least 2.4 m). pad_blend: cells over which the terrain eases to flat floor and full-height ceiling around a stairwell. max_step_per_cell: the steepest rise between two neighbouring corners the data may allow, held by construction (the loader refuses numbers whose bound is higher) and never above the step-up of the body. ground_snap: a grounded body this close above the surface sticks to it when walking downhill.
